source.author: verg
source.text: Talia flammato secum dea corde volutans nimborum in patriam, loca feta furentibus austris, Aeoliam venit.
source.text_original: Talia flammato secum dea corde volutans / nimborum in patriam, loca feta furentibus austris, / Aeoliam venit.
source.text_english: Turning such things over in her fiery heart, the goddess came to Aeolia, the land of storms, home of the winds, pregnant with raging south winds.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illam Acamans habitat nudusque Pyragmon, has nimbi ventique domos et naufraga servat tempestas.
reuse.text_original: illam Acamans habitat nudusque Pyragmon, / has nimbi ventique domos et naufraga servat / tempestas.
reuse.text_english: Acamans dwells in that place, and naked Pyragmon too; these homes are preserved by storms and winds and by shipwrecking tempest.
